verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an optional first-party AI plugin and a built-in LLM chat window that can link to sessions and run commands on your behalf. A hands-on user report describes prompting the feature in natural language to generate an awk command, calling it about 10x faster than searching. Setup requires installing the separate plugin and supplying your own API key. Missing for 10: evidence that commands are inserted in place at the shell prompt rather than produced in a chat/toolbox window, and in-depth first-party docs on the command-generation workflow.
